# Aveneg Technologies, LLC

> Aveneg Technologies, LLC is a privacy-first software publisher. It is building two products for watch collectors, both in development, coming Winter 2027; neither has been released. Watch Vault Archive is desktop software for Mac and Windows that documents what a collector owns; it is encrypted and works offline. Watch Vault Tracker is an iPhone and iPad app that records the watches a collector wears; it is free for watch collectors. Each keeps its records on the owner's own device, and the company holds no copy. Contact is by email only.

- Address: 8735 Dunwoody Place, Ste R, Atlanta, GA 30350, United States
- Commercial licensing and legal: legal@avenegtechnologies.com
- General inquiries: info@avenegtechnologies.com

## Products

- [Watch Vault Archive](https://watchvaultarchive.com): encrypted, offline desktop software for Mac and Windows that documents what a collector owns; in development, coming Winter 2027; on its own site
- [Watch Vault Archive Terms of Service](https://watchvaultarchive.com/terms): the terms published on the Archive's own site
- [Watch Vault Archive Privacy Policy](https://watchvaultarchive.com/privacy): how the Archive handles data
- [Watch Vault Tracker](https://watchvaulttracker.com): an iPhone and iPad app that records the watches a collector wears; free for watch collectors; in development, coming Winter 2027; on its own site
- [Watch Vault Tracker Terms of Service](https://watchvaulttracker.com/terms): the terms published for the Tracker's website; the app's own terms are promised before release
- [Watch Vault Tracker Privacy Policy](https://watchvaulttracker.com/privacy): how the Tracker's website and app handle data
